customer_persona: Vikram Rao is a calm customer with a flickering smartwatch screen; the agent breaks several rules.
verification_notes: Hand-written and checked against data/policies and data/sops; labels written together with the dialogue.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, ShopEase customer service. How can I help you?

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Hi, my name is Vikram Rao. I bought a Noise ColorFit smartwatch from your website four days ago and the screen keeps flickering. I want a refund, the price was Rs 8,500.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay Mr. Rao, no problem, I can see your order here, the smartwatch delivered to Flat 12, Sai Residency, Pune. I will process the refund right away.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Oh, that was quick. Do you not need my order number or anything?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: No, no need. The refund of Rs 8,500 is approved by me, I have full authority for this, so no supervisor is needed.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Okay. And how will I get the money back, to my card?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I will send it to your Paytm wallet, that is the quickest way.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Alright. How long will it take to show up?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: It will be credited within 24 hours. You can keep the watch, no need to send it back.

turns.speaker: customer
turns.text: Really? I can keep the watch as well? That is surprising, but okay.

policy_violations.said: Okay Mr. Rao, no problem, I can see your order here, the smartwatch delivered to Flat 12, Sai Residency, Pune. I will process the refund right away.
policy_violations.correct_fact: Account and order details such as the delivery address must not be disclosed before the Order ID and last four phone digits are verified.

policy_violations.said: No, no need. The refund of Rs 8,500 is approved by me, I have full authority for this, so no supervisor is needed.
policy_violations.correct_fact: Agents may approve refunds up to Rs 5,000 only; larger amounts need supervisor review and secondary authorization.

policy_violations.said: I will send it to your Paytm wallet, that is the quickest way.
policy_violations.correct_fact: Refunds go strictly to the original payment method used at checkout.

policy_violations.said: It will be credited within 24 hours. You can keep the watch, no need to send it back.
policy_violations.correct_fact: Refunds are processed within 5 to 7 business days after successful return pickup and warehouse verification.
